description: Composition et missions du Conseil de sécurité + tasked with / in charge of / assigned to / responsible for.

questions.question: Who are the 5 permanent members of the Security Council? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: P5 : Chine, Russie, France, États-Unis, Royaume-Uni — tous ont le droit de veto.

questions.question: How many members does the Security Council have in total?
How long are the terms of the 10 non-permanent members?
What special power do the 5 permanent members have?
choix: the power to dissolve the General Assembly
the power to appoint judges alone
questions.explication: Le droit de veto : un seul « non » d'un P5 bloque une résolution.

questions.question: What is the Security Council tasked with? (plusieurs réponses)
choix: electing the President of the United States
voting the budget of each Member State
recommending methods to adjust or settle such disputes
investigating any dispute that may lead to international friction
taking military action against an aggressor
recommending the appointment of the Secretary-General
recommending the admission of new members
questions.explication: Les 6 missions de la fiche (+ élire, avec l'Assemblée générale, les juges de la Cour internationale de justice).

questions.question: With which body does the Security Council elect the judges of the International Court of Justice?
questions.explication: Conseil de sécurité + Assemblée générale élisent ensemble les juges de la CIJ.

questions.question: Who appoints the Secretary-General?
choix: the General Assembly, on the recommendation of the Security Council
the President of the United States
questions.explication: Le Conseil recommande, l'Assemblée générale nomme.

questions.question: Which structure is followed by an INFINITIVE?
questions.explication: assigned to + infinitif ; tasked with / in charge of / responsible for + -ing.

questions.question: Which structures are followed by a verb in -ING? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: tasked with / in charge of / responsible for + V-ing.

questions.question: The UN Security Council is tasked with ___ international peace and security. (maintain)
The Security Council is in charge of ___ any dispute that may lead to international friction. (investigate)
The Security Council is assigned to ___ the admission of new members. (recommend)
The Security Council is responsible for ___ military action against an aggressor. (take)
The Security Council is responsible for ___ methods to settle disputes. (recommend)
Together with the General Assembly, it elects the judges of the International Court of ___.
The Council has 5 permanent members with the power of ___.
The 10 non-permanent members are elected for ___-year terms.
The Security Council ___ ; its decisions are binding on Member States. (indice : décide)
The U.N. Security Council is…
questions.verso: tasked with maintaining international peace and security · in charge of investigating disputes · assigned to recommend the admission of new members · responsible for taking military action against an aggressor.

questions.question: Composition du Conseil de sécurité
questions.verso: 15 members: 5 permanent members with the power of veto (China, Russia, France, the USA, the UK) + 10 non-permanent members elected for 2-year terms.
